paper.title: Provably Safe Learning-Augmented Leader Election: Tight Bounds for Permissioned Byzantine Consensus
paper.venue: IEEE TNSE Special Issue 'Theoretical Intelligent Blockchain Networks'
paper.section_using_archives: Section VII.B (D2: Hyperledger Fabric + Caliper, Executed Testbed) and Section VIII.A NE21-NE25 paragraphs

alpha.name: 1-orderer Raft baseline concurrency sweep
alpha.scope: C=1..16, 20 tx/thread, peer chaincode invoke CLI

gamma.name: 5-orderer Raft baseline concurrency sweep
gamma.scope: Same C as alpha but on 5-orderer Raft cluster

beta.name: Caliper Docker multi-seed sweep (FAILED for seeds 2-5)
beta.key_result: seed 1 sustains 96.9 TPS @ rate-100; reported as honest disclosure
beta.paper_use: Honest disclosure paragraph in Caliper section

epsilon.name: Pumba orderer-delay attack injection
epsilon.key_result: +200ms drops C=16 TPS by 81% (45.19 -> 8.55), p99 inflates 9x

eta.name: Caliper clean 5-seed sweep (fresh network/seed)
eta.key_result: 93.9 / 281.18 / 468.38 TPS sustained, 135,120 tx, 0 failures, std<=0.08 TPS

kappa.name: Algorithm 1 simulation via orderer3 stop
kappa.scope: Phase A: +200ms attack on orderer3; Phase B: orderer3 stopped
kappa.key_result: C=16 p99 latency 540 -> 389 ms (-28%); TPS partial recovery only

iota.name: Raft leader failover time
iota.scope: Kill current leader, poll for new-leader election

mu.name: Extended concurrency C=32, 64
mu.scope: C=1,4,16,32,64 native peer chaincode invoke CLI
mu.key_result: CLI ceiling at ~45 TPS (C=16); C=32 has 50% failures

delta.name: Caliper saturation refinement
delta.key_result: Throughput plateau 503-537 TPS, latency 5.7s -> 17s, 270,013 tx 0 failures
delta.supersedes_interpretation_of: beta rate-1000 45% timeouts (now reinterpreted as Caliper SDK 7s window expiration)

campaign_totals.computation_breakdown: alpha+gamma baseline: 3,100; eta Caliper: 135,120; delta Caliper: 270,013; epsilon attack: ~3,300; kappa: ~1,100; mu: ~1,500; iota: 3 failover trials
campaign_totals.total_committed_blocks: 88,468+ (per Raft block height monitor in master log)

honest_disclosures: beta seeds 2-5 produced 0 successes due to cumulative state-DB growth; eta fixes this with fresh-network-per-seed
beta rate-1000 'commit timeouts' are NOT blockchain failures, but Caliper SDK 7s window expirations (proven by delta showing 0 failures up to rate-900)
Algorithm 1 'simulation' in kappa is naive orderer removal; paper's actual mechanism is candidacy-filter (preserves quorum)
ε first attempt invalidated by pumba 'duration < interval' syntax error; valid re-run in 5node_attack_2026-06-07
All measurements on single-host Docker Desktop; production AWS deployment would shift saturation point higher
Native peer chaincode invoke CLI saturates at ~45 TPS (mu); 10x below Fabric Gateway SDK ceiling — CLI is measurement artifact, not Raft bottleneck
